name: Your Turn To Die - Asunaro Participants -
source:
The plot is told from the perspective of Kai Satou, who finds himself trapped in a Death Game with the other nine guests, without a way out. Will they make it out safely, I wonder? Explore the somewhat familiar facility alongside a new cast of characters.

[From [url=https://an-alternative-team.itch.io/yourturntodieasunaroparticipants]itch.io[/url]]
